name: Aloe vera
description: Succulent with thick gel-filled leaves used for burns and skincare. Thrives on neglect and full sun.

name: Cactus mix
description: Desert survivors with sculptural forms and minimal water needs. Excellent for south-facing windows.

name: Caladium
description: Stunning tropical plant with large, colorful heart-shaped leaves in shades of red, pink, and white. Thrives in warm, humid environments.

name: Lavender
description: Fragrant Mediterranean herb with purple flower spikes. Loves dry conditions and plenty of sunlight. Great for borders and aromatherapy.

name: Strawberry
description: Sweet fruiting plant with white flowers and bright red berries. Easy to grow in containers or garden beds with good sunlight.

name: Monstera deliciosa
description: Iconic tropical plant with large, fenestrated leaves. Thrives in bright indirect light and is forgiving of neglect.

name: Pothos
description: Nearly indestructible trailing vine with heart-shaped leaves. Perfect for beginners and low-light spaces.

name: Snake plant
description: Architectural succulent with stiff upright leaves. Tolerates neglect and low light better than almost any plant.

name: Spider plant
description: Cheerful arching plant that produces cascading offshoots. Safe for pets and extremely easy to propagate.

name: Peace lily
description: Elegant shade-loving plant with white spathe flowers. Excellent at filtering indoor air pollutants.

name: ZZ plant
description: Glossy, waxy leaves on graceful arching stems. Survives drought and low light with ease.

name: Rubber plant
description: Bold statement tree with deep burgundy or green leaves. Grows tall and sculptural with minimal care.

name: Fiddle leaf fig
description: Designer darling with large violin-shaped leaves. Loves a bright consistent spot and dislikes being moved.

name: Succulents mix
description: Compact rosette-forming plants in endless variety. Perfect for sunny windowsills and forgetful waterers.

name: Philodendron heartleaf
description: Fast-growing trailing plant with glossy heart-shaped leaves. Adapts to a wide range of light conditions.

name: Chinese evergreen
description: Stunning patterned foliage in shades of green, silver, and red. Very tolerant of low light and neglect.

name: Dracaena
description: Tall architectural plant with strap-like leaves and a cane-like trunk. Excellent air purifier.

name: Boston fern
description: Lush, feathery fronds that add a classic cottage feel. Loves humidity and indirect light.

name: Orchid
description: Elegant blooming plant with exotic flowers lasting weeks. Thrives on bright indirect light and careful watering.

name: African violet
description: Compact flowering plant that blooms almost year-round in purple, pink, and white. Loves bright indirect light.

name: Jade plant
description: Long-lived succulent with thick oval leaves that can live for decades. Symbolizes good luck in many cultures.

name: Kalanchoe
description: Cheerful succulent that produces clusters of tiny flowers in red, orange, and yellow. Blooms for months.

name: Cast iron plant
description: Near indestructible foliage plant that tolerates deep shade, dust, and irregular watering alike.

name: Bird of paradise
description: Dramatic tropical plant with huge paddle-shaped leaves. Makes a bold statement in bright sunny rooms.

name: Prayer plant
description: Striking patterned leaves that fold upward at night as if in prayer. Loves humidity and warmth.

name: Croton
description: Explosively colourful foliage in red, orange, yellow, and green. Needs bright light to keep its vivid colours.

name: English ivy
description: Classic trailing or climbing vine with lobed leaves. Great for hanging baskets and trellises indoors.

name: Bamboo palm
description: Graceful multi-stemmed palm that brings a tropical feel and humidifies the air naturally.
